articles.title: Tech Mahindra shares jump 9% after Q2 results, Jefferies upgrades stock
articles.excerpt:
Tech Mahindra shares jumped 9 per cent after the IT services company reported its September quarter results, with consolidated net profit growth outpacing revenue growth. Brokerages offered mixed views on the stock, with Jefferies upgrading its rating and Motilal Oswal reiterating its buy call, while Citi maintained a sell rating.

Tech Mahindra’s consolidated net profit rose 32.8 per cent year-on-year (y-o-y) to ₹1,586 crore in the second quarter ended September 30, outpacing its 15.6 per cent revenue growth.

articles.title: Rupee relief comes with disruptions in financial markets
articles.excerpt:
The Reserve Bank of India took decisive steps to stabilize the rupee, significantly affecting financial markets. New constraints led to skyrocketing hedging costs and dwindled liquidity in the forex sector. Moreover, bond yields soared to their highest in three years due to escalating oil prices and foreign outflows. Banks brace for possible downturns and reduced foreign-exchange dealings in the next quarter.

articles.title: Rupee rises 20 paise to 94.79 against US dollar in early trade
articles.excerpt:
The rupee reached 94.79 against the US dollar following structural forex interventions by the Reserve Bank of India. Elevated crude oil prices and declining equity markets limited the currency's gains. The dollar index decreased by 0.54 per cent, reflecting the dollar's weakened strength. While US retail sales exceeded forecasts, the Producer Price Index was unexpectedly high. Foreign Institutional Investors also offloaded significant equities on Thursday, impacting domestic market performance.
